body.name: Fixed-query conditionally independent-calendar subclass
body.construction:
For every fixed admissible query \(z_0\), define
\[
 \mathcal M^{\mathrm{iid}}_{N,T,\mathbf n}(z_0)
 =\left\{\xi\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}(z_0):
 (X_{s1},\ldots,X_{sT})\text{ are independent under }\mathbb K_\xi
 \text{ for every }s\right\}.
\]
Only the design dates are required to be independent.  Dependence across
calendar dates inside one unit's response history remains unrestricted.
